# peakhour_domain_plan (Resource)

Assigns a subscription plan to a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_domain_plan" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
  code   = "business2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Plan code to assign to the domain (e.g. 'basic', 'premium').
- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `use_existing` (Boolean) If true, subscribe to an existing account plan. If false (default), create a new plan subscription.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Domain plan identifier (domain/plan).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_domain_plan.example example.com
```
